title: DecentRaise
tagline: A crowdfunding dao that empowers creators, connect backers, and bring ideas to life. Our platform combines blockchain transparency, analytics, and rewards to fuel innovation.
description:
DecentraRaise is an innovative crowdfunding platform that uses cutting-edge technology to bring together creative people and passionate backers. We are changing the way crowdfunding is done by adding blockchain transparency, advanced analytics, and personalised rewards.

DecentraRaise works as a dynamic hub to allow backers give money, and also allow creators get their money right away. With these, you get a streamlined experience that builds trust and gets things done quickly.

This platform was made with both creators and backers in mind. It acts as a link between visionaries and the people who help them. Creators show off their projects with interesting campaigns that invite backers to check them out and help. Each contribution is safely recorded on the blockchain, which makes sure that everything is open and clear.

Backers are an important part of the journey, and the rewards they get are based on how much they contribute. From exclusive digital assets to personalised goods, these rewards show how creators and backers can work together to make something great.
how_its_made:
The project was built using a mix of modern tools and technologies. For the part that users see and interact with (the frontend), we used Reactjs along with Vite and Tailwind CSS. These helped create a good-looking and easy-to-use interface. To make this part work together with the behind-the-scenes stuff (the backend), we used a tool called Ethers.js. This tool helped the frontend talk to the Ethereum blockchain, so things like creating crowdfunding campaigns, adding money, and making special digital items were done smoothly. This way, we made sure that the whole platform works well and keeps users' actions safe and reliable. By putting all these pieces together, we made a user-friendly crowdfunding platform that also works with the blockchain technology.
We deployed on optimism, base and zora. We also tried to integrate worldcoin but it was too late. Overall, the hackathon was a good experience
